summary: AI-Driven Learning Dashboard: React frontend dashboard where Summary and Quiz are populated from a single ActivePieces webhook response after file upload. Ask AI functionality is currently hidden/disabled in the UI (the entire Ask AI section, input field, and button are not shown). Frontend must ONLY use VITE_WEBHOOK_URL (remove VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL/VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL from code, env templates, and error checks). No database/Supabase persistence; UI updates from local state without refresh. All backend interactions via POST.
architectural_notes: Backend is ActivePieces automation; frontend integrates via webhooks (URLs provided later).
Summary/Quiz/AI Answer must be derived strictly from backend responses; no DB/Supabase persistence; store in local React state.
Ask AI requests must include user_question plus uploaded_notes/context.
Frontend will use one webhook URL for both flows; requests must include an action/type field so backend can route: file upload => summary+quiz, Ask AI => ai_answer.
Support single webhook URL configuration only; remove/ignore separate Endpoint A/B URL configuration in the frontend (one URL used for both actions with action discriminator).
Frontend configuration is single-URL only: read ONLY VITE_WEBHOOK_URL; remove VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL/VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL from codepaths, env templates, and error checks.

ActivePieces webhook URL provided for configuration/testing: https://cloud.activepieces.com/api/v1/webhooks/arB5MIDx32mR1vdmBIC0r/sync (to be set as VITE_WEBHOOK_URL in frontend/.env or deployment env).
Ask AI UI is intentionally hidden/disabled (entire section removed from view, including input and button) until re-enabled.
known_issues: File upload currently fails with user-facing error: "No webhook URL configured. Please set VITE_WEBHOOK_URL in your environment variables." (indicates VITE_WEBHOOK_URL missing in current deployment environment).

User cannot find/access the deployment Environment Variables panel in the hosting UI (sidebar appears hidden/collapsed or blocked by popups), preventing setting VITE_WEBHOOK_URL and leaving the app stuck on the "No webhook URL configured" error.
Deployment pipeline currently failing with error: "You don't have a draft yet" (deployer expects a draft version but no draft build was created).

existing_features.title: Implement a configuration mechanism for two external ActivePieces webhook URLs (Endpoint A for file processing; Endpoint B for Ask AI) without hardcoding them. Use environment variables (e.g., VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL and VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL) and show a clear, user-facing error in English if either URL is missing when an action is triggered.

Build the main dashboard page that updates purely from in-memory React state (no database/Supabase) and renders Summary + Quiz immediately after a successful file-upload response without page refresh.

Implement the file upload flow that sends a POST request to Endpoint A with the uploaded notes file and parses the JSON response containing a summary string and a quiz_array. Store summary and quiz_array in local state for rendering.
Render the Summary section as a clean, readable container that displays the summary string from the Endpoint A response.

Implement the Interactive Quiz component that consumes quiz_array items shaped like {"question": string, "options": ["A","B","C","D"], "correct_answer": string}. Display questions in a top-to-bottom list with A/B/C/D as vertical buttons and provide per-question answer validation feedback.
Add quiz management controls: a View toggle to show/hide the quiz list and a Delete action that removes the quiz content from local state immediately.

Implement the "Ask AI" module that uses Endpoint B as a separate, on-demand POST request. The request must include user_question plus the uploaded_notes context (derived from the previously uploaded file content or stored text context), and the response must include only ai_answer which is then rendered in the UI.

Add loading and reset behaviors for Ask AI: show an English loading state (exact text: "AI is thinking...") while awaiting Endpoint B; include a Delete/Clear button that clears the ai_answer and resets the input field immediately.

Create a coherent minimalist, modern, responsive visual theme (not blue/purple) and apply it consistently across Auth screens and the Dashboard (typography, spacing, card styles, buttons, states for success/error/loading).

Implement authentication UX using Internet Identity (supported on the Internet Computer) instead of username/password, Google OAuth, email verification, and password reset. Provide a single sign-in/sign-out flow and gate the dashboard behind authentication.

Allow the app to be configured with a single ActivePieces webhook URL for both file upload processing and Ask AI by supporting the case where VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL and VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL point to the same URL and by providing a fallback so that if only one of these environment variables is set, the app uses the configured one for both actions.

When calling the single ActivePieces webhook URL, include an explicit action discriminator in the POST request body so the external automation can route the request appropriately: file uploads must send action="process_notes" and expect {summary, quiz_array}; Ask AI must send action="ask_ai" along with user_question and uploaded_notes and expect {ai_answer}.

Update the frontend configuration documentation/template to reflect that a single webhook URL can be used for both actions, while still supporting separate URLs, and ensure all guidance is in English.

Remove the two-URL webhook configuration option from the frontend and replace it with a single webhook URL configuration used for both file upload (process_notes) and Ask AI (ask_ai). Use one environment variable only (e.g., VITE_WEBHOOK_URL).
Update the frontend environment variable template/documentation to reflect the single-URL-only configuration and remove the dual-URL guidance.

When file upload or Ask AI fails due to missing VITE_WEBHOOK_URL, show an in-app help section that explains how to configure VITE_WEBHOOK_URL (in English) and provides copy-paste snippets the user can use to set the variable.

Add a short, repo-local documentation file describing how to configure the ActivePieces webhook for this app using ONLY VITE_WEBHOOK_URL, including an explicit copy-paste block and common troubleshooting notes for the missing-variable error.

Update the frontend webhook configuration help UI to include the user-provided webhook URL (https://cloud.activepieces.com/api/v1/webhooks/arB5MIDx32mR1vdmBIC0r/sync) as a ready-to-copy example for VITE_WEBHOOK_URL.

Update the frontend environment template (frontend/.env.example) to provide the user-provided webhook URL (https://cloud.activepieces.com/api/v1/webhooks/arB5MIDx32mR1vdmBIC0r/sync) as the example value for VITE_WEBHOOK_URL.

Add an in-app way for users to enter and save the ActivePieces webhook URL when the app is missing `VITE_WEBHOOK_URL`, so the app can still process file uploads and Ask AI without requiring access to the hosting Environment Variables UI.

Implement a persistent client-side storage for the webhook URL override (e.g., localStorage) and update the webhook resolution logic so requests use the override URL when present; otherwise use `import.meta.env.VITE_WEBHOOK_URL`.

Update the existing missing-webhook help UI to include a ready-to-use input field and actions: Save webhook URL and Clear saved webhook URL, and ensure it prominently explains that setting environment variables may be unavailable and that the URL can be set inside the app.
Add basic validation for the user-provided webhook URL in the UI (non-empty and must start with http:// or https://) and display a clear English error message if invalid.

Update the in-app webhook setup UI so that when no webhook URL override is currently saved, the input field is pre-populated with the user-provided webhook URL `https://cloud.activepieces.com/api/v1/webhooks/arB5MIDx32mR1vdmBIC0r/sync` to enable one-click saving.

Revise the missing-webhook user-facing error text so it clearly indicates that the webhook can be configured either by setting `VITE_WEBHOOK_URL` or by saving a webhook URL inside the app (via the Webhook Configuration panel).
Create a new build draft using the current repository state and run the standard build + deployment pipeline to produce a fresh deployment.

Modify the Dashboard page UI to completely hide the entire “Ask AI” section so it is not visible anywhere in the frontend, including the section heading, chat/question input field, and the “Ask AI” submit button.

Update the Interactive Quiz option onClick/feedback rendering so that after a user selects an answer: (1) if the selected answer is correct, the clicked option’s background turns green; (2) if the selected answer is incorrect, the clicked option’s background turns red AND the option matching correct_answer immediately turns green at the same time (within the same question).

Add a separate Delete control (trash icon) specifically for the Summary section by placing an icon button in the top-right corner of the Summary card; when clicked, it must clear only the summary text (reset Summary to empty) and must not modify the Quiz section/state in any way.

Wire the Summary delete button into Dashboard state management by providing a Summary delete handler that clears only the summary state and passing it into the Summary card component without changing the existing Quiz delete handler.

Implement (or re-implement) the dedicated Summary Delete control as a trash icon button in the top-right corner of the Summary card. When clicked, it must clear ONLY the Summary text (set summary state to an empty string) and must not modify the Quiz section/state in any way.

Wire the Summary Delete button into Dashboard state management by adding a Summary delete handler in the Dashboard page and passing it into the SummaryCard component via props, without changing the existing Quiz delete handler or QuizSection behavior.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build React dashboard UI that populates Summary + Quiz from backend response immediately after file upload (no refresh, local state only)
Implement file upload flow that POSTs to Endpoint A and receives summary + quiz_array response
Implement Ask AI module that POSTs user_question + uploaded_notes to separate Endpoint B and displays returned ai_answer with loading + clear actions
Interactive Quiz component: parse quiz JSON, render vertical list of questions/options, validate correct/incorrect with button color feedback, plus view toggle and delete-from-state
Auth UI flows: login/signup with email verification gating activation, Google OAuth option, and forgot-password reset UI
Enforce no database persistence for summary/quiz/ai content (disconnect Supabase/DB); only use backend responses into frontend state
Support using a single ActivePieces webhook URL for both file upload and Ask AI by sending an explicit action/type in the POST body (e.g., process_notes vs ask_ai) and parsing responses accordingly
Simplify webhook configuration to a single URL only (remove/ignore two-URL option VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL/VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL); use one env var for both actions and keep clear English error when missing

Remove all remaining references to the legacy environment variables VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL and VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL from the frontend codebase, including any fallback/dual-URL logic, configuration helpers, and request builders, so the app ONLY reads VITE_WEBHOOK_URL for both "process_notes" and "ask_ai" actions.
Ensure all user-facing error messages and validation checks related to webhook configuration mention ONLY VITE_WEBHOOK_URL (in English) and never mention VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL or VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL.
Update and verify environment-variable template/documentation in the project to contain ONLY VITE_WEBHOOK_URL and remove any legacy guidance that mentions VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL or VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL.

Update the repo-local webhook setup documentation (frontend/WEBHOOK_SETUP.md) to include a copy-paste snippet using the user-provided webhook URL (https://cloud.activepieces.com/api/v1/webhooks/arB5MIDx32mR1vdmBIC0r/sync).

Update repo-local webhook setup documentation to include a copy-paste snippet using the exact user-provided webhook URL `https://cloud.activepieces.com/api/v1/webhooks/arB5MIDx32mR1vdmBIC0r/sync`, and ensure all documentation text is in English.
Hide/disable the entire 'Ask AI' UI section (including chat input field and the 'Ask AI' button) so it is not visible in the frontend
Quiz option onClick behavior: if user selects incorrect option, mark selected red and simultaneously highlight the correct_answer option green; if user selects correct option, mark it green

Add a dedicated Summary-section Delete button (trash icon) in the top-right of the Summary card that clears only the summary text without affecting the Quiz; visually distinct from the Quiz delete button
Create a new build draft from the updated repository state and run the standard build + deployment pipeline to produce a fresh deployment.

projectName: AI-Driven Learning Dashboard UI wired to a single ActivePieces webhook URL (POST-only, no persistence)
